summary: A news story's lede opens on the body or business that acted, then says what it did.
realLife: In 7 of 11 stories read, the first sentence names the council, board or business and its act. Ledes run about 17 to 54 words, middle value 31, packing three to six facts.
sources: docs/story/research/news-and-week-moves.md (Fixer A, Nov 24, 2026: 11 local stories read whole, coded by paragraph role)
